attributedDescription.content:
リオ: Now we have songs from the Otome cute album, starting out with this colourful(colorful), mellow medley. This album is a sort of hybrid, with the first few songs catered to more of the bossa nova side of Shibayan whilst the others envision Shibayan’s electro side. Makes it a rather unique album for listening to in that sense. 

カラフル・メロウ・メドレー
A Colourful, Mellow Medley
